title: Implicit Graph Conjecture
exact_target: Must every hereditary graph family with at most factorially many labeled graphs have logarithmic-size vertex labels from which adjacency can be decoded?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1439 (GRAPH-052). CC BY 4.0.
Hamed Hatami and Pooya Hatami, The Implicit Graph Conjecture Is False, arXiv:2111.13198v2 (2021), Section 1, Conjecture 1.3 and Theorem 1.4, pages 1--3.
